compiled_state.title: Implement ticket-scratch-get.sh with hit/miss exit-0 semantics
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: `scratch get` returns `{status:"hit",ts,value}` exit 0 on hit OR `{status:"miss",ticket_id,key}` exit 0 on miss (NOT non-zero); both shapes and exit codes asserted by behavioral tests

## Description

Create plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-get.sh. Calls `_scratch_resolve_and_validate`, then `_scratch_read_envelope`. On hit, emits `{status:"hit",ts:<from envelope>,value:<from envelope>}` with exit 0. On miss (file not found OR empty), emits `{status:"miss",ticket_id,key}` with exit 0. The miss-exit-0 contract is load-bearing: orchestrators distinguish presence via the `status` field, not the exit code.

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)

Given an existing scratch envelope with `value:"v"`; When `dso ticket scratch get` runs; Then exit code is 0 AND stdout matches `{status:"hit",ts:<iso8601>,value:"v"}`. Given no file at the target path; When `dso ticket scratch get` runs; Then exit code is 0 (NOT non-zero) AND stdout is `{status:"miss",ticket_id,key}`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] scratch get on existing key emits `{status:"hit",ts,value}` with exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-get.sh
- [ ] scratch get on missing key emits `{status:"miss",ticket_id,key}` with exit 0 (NOT non-zero)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-get.sh
- [ ] New script and test are executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-get.sh && test -x tests/scratch/test-scratch-get.sh

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-get.sh | Create |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-get.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
